summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Varta Verde. 14/14 pytest backend tests passed. All 4 advisor pages (Machinery, Crops, Livelihood, Seeds) confirmed to RENDER result panels after clicking their Calculate buttons. Schemes eligibility, filter chips, Veda chat (millet + SMAM), and EN/HI language toggle all functional. No JS console errors detected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py check_eligibility currently marks every scheme as eligible=True regardless of profile — the 'women' filter branch is a no-op (ok = ok). If real filtering is required, refine the rule.
seed_db uses on_event('startup') and wipes all collections on every boot — fine for demo but destroys any user data if added later.
chat handler falls back to first item when keyword not matched (e.g. 'best millet for drought' returns first crop even if not a millet) — currently works because crops[0] is Bajra, but is fragile.
seed_data_creation: None — backend auto-seeds on startup from seed_data.py
context_for_next_testing_agent: All key flows verified via public URL. data-testids used: calc-machinery, calc-crops, calc-livelihood, calc-seeds, find-subsidies, filter-Horticulture, veda-fab/panel/input/send, lang-toggle. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_varta_verde.py — run: pytest backend/tests/test_varta_verde.py -v
